checked.found: Caxton's Sarum Ordinal handbill is catalogued c.1476-77 (Bodleian, John Rylands); the earliest surviving printed English advertisement. 1477 is within the evidence window; description is fair (surviving, not strictly first).
Boston News-Letter began 24 April 1704; the Oyster Bay property notice is reported in a 1704 issue (8 May 1704 per one blog). MHS calls it the first paid newspaper ad in America. Year 1704 holds.
Quaker Oats man registered as a trademark in 1877, the first for a breakfast cereal.
V&A says Barratt bought the Millais painting in 1886 (Smarthistory says 1887); 1886 is the museum-backed year.
Kodak camera and slogan launched 1888.
Bibendum debuted on O'Galop's 1898 poster.
Most sources put the slogan and umbrella girl on the blue package in 1914 (one source says 1911 campaign planning).
Antonio Gentile's schoolboy drawing won Planters' 1916 contest.
Betty Crocker name created 1921 by Washburn-Crosby.
Burma-Shave rhyming signs began 1925 in Minnesota.
Wheaties Quartet jingle first aired Dec 1926 on Minneapolis radio, widely credited as first singing commercial.
Haddon Sundblom's first Coca-Cola Santa ads, 1931.
Borden's Elsie introduced 1936.
Smokey Bear poster by Albert Staehle, August 1944.
Frances Gerety's De Beers slogan, 1947.
Tony the Tiger introduced 1952 on Sugar Frosted Flakes.
Leo Burnett conceived the campaign in 1954 (Wikipedia: first appearance 1954); some sources say ads debuted publicly in 1955. 1954 is the start year.
DDB's Think Small ad, 1959.
Willard Scott's Ronald McDonald on local Washington DC TV, 1963.
Poppin' Fresh debuted 1965 (Leo Burnett).
Hilltop ad aired July 1971.
Milton Glaser logo and campaign, 1977.
Ridley Scott's ad aired during Super Bowl XVIII, January 1984; name and description carry no date.
Just Do It launched 1988 by Wieden+Kennedy.
Got Milk? created 1993 for California milk processors (celebrity moustaches followed from 1994-95; description is loosely fine).
Think Different launched 1997 with Steve Jobs's return.
Whassup? ad debuted on Monday Night Football, December 1999.
Evolution film released online in 2006 (wider Real Beauty campaign began 2004).
Old Spice 'The Man Your Man Could Smell Like' aired February 2010; name is 33 chars.
